The '''1962–63 Turkish National League''' was the fifth season of professional [[football in Turkey]] and the last year the top division in Turkey was named the Turkish National League. With the creation of the 2.Lig in 1963–64, the top-flight football division in Turkey would be re-branded as the 1.Lig. [[Galatasaray S.K. (football team)|Galatasaray]] won their second league title.<ref name=rsssf>{{cite web | url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablest/turkhist.html | title=Turkey - Final Tables | website=[[RSSSF]] | access-date=15 October 2010}}</ref><ref name=turkishsoccer>{{cite web | url=https://www.angelfire.com/nj/sivritepe/6263/tl.html | title=1962-1963 Milli Lig | author=Sivritepe, Erdinç | publisher=turkish-soccer.com | access-date=15 October 2010}}</ref><ref name=tff>{{cite web | url=http://www.tff.org/default.aspx?pageID=379 | title=SPOR TOTO SÜPER LİG ŞAMPİYONLUKLARI | publisher=tff.org | language=tr | access-date=15 October 2010}}</ref>

==Overview==
[[Galatasaray S.K. (football team)|Galatasaray]] won their second title, becoming the first club to win back-to-back league titles. [[Beşiktaş J.K.|Beşiktaş]] finished runners-up, with [[Fenerbahçe S.K.|Fenerbahçe]] rounding out the top three. [[Galatasaray S.K. (football team)|Galatasaray]] qualified for the [[1963–64 European Cup|European Cup]]. With Galatasaray having already qualified for the European Cup, [[Turkish Cup]] runners-up [[Fenerbahçe S.K.|Fenerbahçe]] were sent to compete in the [[1963–64 European Cup Winners' Cup|European Cup Winners' Cup]] instead. [[Altay S.K.|Altay]] qualified for the [[Balkans Cup]] and the [[1963–64 Inter-Cities Fairs Cup|Inter-Cities Fairs Cup]], and [[Beşiktaş J.K.|Beşiktaş]] qualified for the [[Balkans Cup]]. [[Metin Oktay]] finished top scorer with a total of 38 goals; 16 in the group stages and 22 in the finals.<ref name=turkishsoccer />

A new format was put into place for this season only: the 22 clubs competing were split into two groups of 11. The top six clubs from each group qualified for the final group. Clubs finishing 7 to 9 qualified for the classification group, while clubs in 10th and 11th place were relegated to the newly created [[TFF First League|2.Lig]]. The final group consisted of twelve clubs and was played as if it were a regular league, except no clubs were relegated. The clubs who qualified for the classification group played each other twice to decide who would be ranked from 13th to 18th place. [[Fatih Karagümrük|Karagümrük]], [[Etimesgut Şekerspor|Şeker Hilal]], [[Vefa S.K.|Vefa]], and [[Yeşildirek SK|Yeşildirek]] were relegated.<ref name=turkishsoccer />
